messages:
lee: Heads-up: found a few embed export rows with email fragments and short phone-like tokens. tiny count but repeatable in canary. :grimacing:

nina: Which route/version? SDK or direct traffic?

lee: /v1/realtime/embed, mix of SDK v1.x and direct. some shorthands like 'sam@org' without TLD plus spaced phone fragments.

ash: Short-term patch: ingress should redact aggressively before any telemetry export. Long-term: keep encrypted raw and only export a redacted copy.

taylor: Important: enterprise customers need raw logs sometimes for legal ops. We must provide an explicit opt-in that requires customer KMS and RBAC so Redwood can't unwrap.

priya: UX: console shows a redacted inline preview. "Request raw" is a three-step flow: 1) justification text, 2) select audit category, 3) confirm 2FA. Raw view is in-memory only and auto-reseals after 30 mins.

ash: Implementation notes: hosted -> Redwood KMS wraps keys; unmask writes an immutable audit record with operator id and justification. Private -> require customer KMS, deny Redwood unwraps. Delayed-unmask means raw stays encrypted for configured retention and only decrypted for the session.

lee: Can we add a small header for hints? e.g. `X-Redwood-Redact-Hint: pii=email;phone` for proxies, but we should treat it as advisory.

nina: Agree on hint semantics: accept but ignore for final export logic. We'll log hints (hashed) to help tune heuristics. Don't use them to decide whether to export raw.

priya: Sampler idea: base_rate per-route (0.1%), reactive window on redaction_misses or route-error spike -> scale up to 10% for N minutes, with tenant_daily_cap and a tenant_burst_quota. Any unmask operation must decrement tenant_burst_quota.

ash: Metrics to add: redaction_misses counter (per-route, per-tenant), scrubbed_ratio, hashed_examples heatmap (store only salted hashes), and unmask_audit_count. Add alert if unmask_audit_count > threshold in 24h.

lee: Quick regex to push to canary ingress as a stopgap: `re.sub(r"[\w._%+-]+@[\w.-]+(\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})?","[REDACTED_EMAIL]", payload)` catches missing-TLDs. Gate ML scrubbers behind feature flag.

priya: Policy: manual unmask creates immutable snapshot id and audit entry: {operator, justification, snapshot_id, ttl_minutes}. Snapshot access logs surfaced in console under "Audit -> Unmasks".

infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy ingress-redact v4 -> prod/us-east-1 started (build 7124).

lee: Action items:
- ash + taylor: short RFC for quota-aware sampler + delayed-unmask (due Fri)
- priya: console mock for unmask flow + audit view (due Tue)
- nina: instrument redaction_misses + hashed heatmap (PR this week)

lee: If any high-severity PII leaks found in canary, pause embedding telemetry export until key-wrap & audited-unmask are live.
